# KappaN2 {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
KappaN2()
```
Variant 2 of the nominal κ-chart ([`KappaN`](@ref)); the marginal probabilities are kept fixed at their in-control values and only the agreement statistic is smoothed.
 


:::
